cases.title: With Tidy labels on, answering Yes moves the P8 invert text clear of the SPOT LEVEL block, and one U puts it back exactly where it was
cases.plan_item: UX-LBL-03 Tidy labels for a sheet, Apply and one U (top-40 item 31), switch ON
cases.expected: As R16, CDTIDYLABELS All says '[CE] Will move 1' and names 'pipe P8 -> open end start invert text would move 275 mm (further out).'; the Yes answer prints '[CE] Moved 1' and 'Type U once to put every label back.'; the IL 18.000 text has moved more than 100 mm; the Civil log says 'Command outcome: CDTIDYLABELS completed'; one U echoes CDTIDYLABELS and puts the text back within 0.5 mm of where it was; the object count is the same throughout.
cases.why_not_unit: The move and its undo group are made by the live command in the real drawing; only AutoCAD's own U shows that one step takes every label back.
not_automated: REDO after the U is NOT driven (BUG-861 family). A whole sheet with many labels is not driven: one label moves here.
Where the text lands (clear, readable) is a Codex look.
